repos.name: docker/docker-agent
repos.description: AI Agent Builder and Runtime by Docker Engineering
repos.one_liner: An official AI agent builder and runtime environment integrated directly into the Docker ecosystem.
bullets: Built in Go, leveraging Docker's native containerization and orchestration primitives.
Provides a standardized runtime for deploying and managing autonomous AI agents.
Simplifies the infrastructure layer for developers building agentic workflows.
Enables secure, isolated execution environments for LLM-driven automation tasks.

repos.name: yetone/magpie
repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.one_liner: A unified menu bar interface for managing and switching between various LLM models and agentic workflows.
bullets: Written in Go, providing a high-performance, lightweight desktop utility.
Acts as a centralized hub for interacting with diverse models like DeepSeek and Claude.
Streamlines the developer experience by abstracting model-specific API complexities.
Ideal for power users needing rapid access to AI-assisted coding and reasoning tasks.

repos.name: storytold/photocraft
repos.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop in pure Rust
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop built entirely in Rust.
bullets: Developed in Rust to ensure memory safety and high-concurrency image processing.
Focuses on modular, open-source architecture to replace proprietary creative software.
Provides a foundation for building custom, high-speed image manipulation pipelines.
Relevant for infrastructure-heavy creative workflows requiring programmatic control.

repos.name: storytold/printcraft
repos.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Acrobat built in pure Rust
repos.one_liner: A clean-room, open-source reimplementation of Adobe Acrobat built in pure Rust.
bullets: Utilizes Rust's type system to handle complex PDF parsing and rendering safely.
Designed as a modular library for document processing and manipulation.
Provides a secure, transparent alternative to closed-source enterprise document tools.
Useful for fintech and legal tech stacks requiring automated, verifiable document generation.

repos.name: nullmoth/nvidia-macos-driver
repos.description: Metal driver for NVIDIA GeForce RTX cards on macOS 15 Sequoia (Intel / OpenCore). Free, source included.
repos.one_liner: A community-driven Metal driver enabling NVIDIA RTX GPU acceleration on macOS Sequoia.
bullets: Written in Rust, focusing on low-level kernel-space driver development.
Bridges the gap between high-end NVIDIA hardware and Apple's Metal graphics API.
Enables cost-effective AI training and rendering setups on non-Apple silicon hardware.
Critical for developers building local AI/ML infrastructure on macOS-based workstations.
